pages.text_en: Emmy and Birch were ready for adventure! Emmy had a brand-new helmet and matching boots made of yellow gold. Birch had a brand-new sword made of iron.

sentences.text_en: Emmy and Birch were ready for adventure!
sentences.zh: Emmy 和 Birch 已经准备好去冒险了！

sentences.text_en: Emmy had a brand-new helmet and matching boots made of yellow gold.
sentences.zh: Emmy 戴着崭新的头盔，穿着配套的黄色金靴。

sentences.text_en: Birch had a brand-new sword made of iron.
sentences.zh: Birch 有一把崭新的铁剑。

pages.text_en:
Byte, their loyal wolf, just wanted to play. "We can play fetch," said Emmy. "Ready, boy?" asked Birch.
"FETCH!"

sentences.text_en: Byte, their loyal wolf, just wanted to play.
sentences.zh: 他们忠诚的狼 Byte 只想玩耍。

sentences.text_en: "We can play fetch," said Emmy.
sentences.zh: “我们可以玩接球，”Emmy 说。

sentences.text_en: "Ready, boy?" asked Birch.
sentences.zh: “准备好了吗，小家伙？”Birch 问。

pages.text_en:
Byte ran after the stick. But he did not return. "Where did he go?" asked Birch. They both called him.
They did not find Byte, but they saw something strange. Beneath the trees, they found a rectangle of blocks made of black obsidian. The air glowed purple inside it. *

sentences.text_en: Byte ran after the stick.
sentences.zh: Byte 追着木棍跑去。

sentences.text_en: But he did not return.
sentences.zh: 可是它没有回来。

sentences.text_en: "Where did he go?" asked Birch.
sentences.zh: “它去哪儿了？”Birch 问。

sentences.text_en: They both called him.
sentences.zh: 他们俩一起呼唤它。

sentences.text_en: They did not find Byte, but they saw something strange.
sentences.zh: 他们没有找到 Byte，却看见了奇怪的东西。

sentences.text_en: Beneath the trees, they found a rectangle of blocks made of black obsidian.
sentences.zh: 在树下，他们发现了一块由黑曜石方块组成的长方形。

sentences.text_en: The air glowed purple inside it.
sentences.zh: 里面的空气泛着紫光。

pages.text_en:
It's a portal to the Nether," said Emmy. She put her hand into the purple light. Her hand disappeared!
"Do you think Byte went through the portal?" asked Birch. There is only one way to find out," said Emmy. "Come on!"

sentences.text_en: It's a portal to the Nether," said Emmy.
sentences.zh: “这是通往下界的传送门，”Emmy 说。

sentences.text_en: She put her hand into the purple light.
sentences.zh: 她把手伸进紫色的光里。

sentences.text_en: Her hand disappeared!
sentences.zh: 她的手消失了！

sentences.text_en: "Do you think Byte went through the portal?" asked Birch.
sentences.zh: “你觉得 Byte 穿过传送门了吗？”Birch 问。

sentences.text_en: There is only one way to find out," said Emmy.
sentences.zh: “只有一个办法能知道，”Emmy 说。

sentences.text_en: "Come on!"
sentences.zh: “走吧！”

pages.text_en:
The two friends leaped into the portal. At first, Birch thought they were still in the forest.
Then he saw that the trees were blue-green. So was the grass.

sentences.text_en: The two friends leaped into the portal.
sentences.zh: 两个朋友跳进了传送门。

sentences.text_en: At first, Birch thought they were still in the forest.
sentences.zh: 一开始，Birch 以为他们还在森林里。

sentences.text_en: Then he saw that the trees were blue-green.
sentences.zh: 后来他发现树木是蓝绿色的。

sentences.text_en: So was the grass.
sentences.zh: 草也是蓝绿色的。

pages.text_en:
Birch and Emmy climbed a pair of vines to get a better view of the Nether. Birch gasped in surprise.
He saw a gray desert. He saw a red woodland. And he saw an ocean of lava.

sentences.text_en: Birch and Emmy climbed a pair of vines to get a better view of the Nether.
sentences.zh: Birch 和 Emmy 爬上两根藤蔓，好看清下界的景象。

sentences.text_en: Birch gasped in surprise.
sentences.zh: Birch 惊讶地倒吸了一口气。

sentences.text_en: He saw a gray desert.
sentences.zh: 他看见了一片灰色的沙漠。

sentences.text_en: He saw a red woodland.
sentences.zh: 他看见了一片红色的林地。

sentences.text_en: And he saw an ocean of lava.
sentences.zh: 他还看见了一片岩浆海。

pages.text_en:
Birch had never seen any place like this in Minecraft. "Even the mushrooms are strange!" Emmy told him with a laugh. She put two blue-green fungi in her inventory.
Setting out to find Byte, they started walking. The strange blue-green forest became a strange red forest.

sentences.text_en: Birch had never seen any place like this in Minecraft.
sentences.zh: 在 Minecraft 里，Birch 从没见过这样的地方。

sentences.text_en: "Even the mushrooms are strange!" Emmy told him with a laugh.
sentences.zh: “连蘑菇都很奇怪！”Emmy 笑着告诉他。

sentences.text_en: She put two blue-green fungi in her inventory.
sentences.zh: 她把两株蓝绿色真菌放进了物品栏。

sentences.text_en: Setting out to find Byte, they started walking.
sentences.zh: 他们出发去寻找 Byte，开始向前走。

sentences.text_en: The strange blue-green forest became a strange red forest.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的蓝绿色森林变成了奇怪的红色森林。

pages.text_en:
Birch raised his hand. They were being watched. Birch's warning was too late. Strange mobs surrounded them. "Piglins!" cried Emmy.
The piglins attacked Birch! But they left Emmy alone. They liked her gold helmet and gold boots.

sentences.text_en: Birch raised his hand.
sentences.zh: Birch 举起了手。

sentences.text_en: They were being watched.
sentences.zh: 有人正在监视他们。

sentences.text_en: Birch's warning was too late.
sentences.zh: 可是 Birch 的警告来得太晚了。

sentences.text_en: Strange mobs surrounded them.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的生物把他们包围了。

sentences.text_en: "Piglins!" cried Emmy.
sentences.zh: “猪灵！”Emmy 喊道。

sentences.text_en: The piglins attacked Birch!
sentences.zh: 猪灵们向 Birch 发起了攻击！

sentences.text_en: But they left Emmy alone.
sentences.zh: 但它们没有碰 Emmy。

sentences.text_en: They liked her gold helmet and gold boots.
sentences.zh: 它们喜欢 Emmy 的金头盔和金靴子。

pages.text_en:
Emmy had an idea! She took off her gold helmet and put it on Birch's head. The piglins stopped fighting Birch.
The mobs oinked with happiness. Emmy and Birch followed them to a huge fortress.

sentences.text_en: Emmy had an idea!
sentences.zh: Emmy 想到了一个办法！

sentences.text_en: She took off her gold helmet and put it on Birch's head.
sentences.zh: 她摘下自己的金头盔，戴到了 Birch 头上。

sentences.text_en: The piglins stopped fighting Birch.
sentences.zh: 猪灵们停止攻击 Birch。

sentences.text_en: The mobs oinked with happiness.
sentences.zh: 这些生物开心地哼哼起来。

sentences.text_en: Emmy and Birch followed them to a huge fortress.
sentences.zh: Emmy 和 Birch 跟着它们来到一座巨大的堡垒。

pages.text_en:
In the fortress, they found a treasure room filled with gold. Birch opened a chest. The piglins drew their swords and made angry noises!
Emmy and Birch escaped the mobs by smashing a big hole in the wall. On the other side was a desert.

sentences.text_en: In the fortress, they found a treasure room filled with gold.
sentences.zh: 在堡垒里，他们找到了一间堆满黄金的宝藏室。

sentences.text_en: Birch opened a chest.
sentences.zh: Birch 打开了一个箱子。

sentences.text_en: The piglins drew their swords and made angry noises!
sentences.zh: 猪灵们拔出剑，发出了愤怒的声音！

sentences.text_en: Emmy and Birch escaped the mobs by smashing a big hole in the wall.
sentences.zh: Emmy 和 Birch 砸穿墙壁上的大洞，逃离了这些生物。

sentences.text_en: On the other side was a desert.
sentences.zh: 墙的另一边是一片沙漠。

pages.text_en:
Piglins chased them. It was very difficult to run. "This is not ordinary sand," said Emmy. "It is soul sand!"
Skeletons also started firing arrows at them! Emmy and Birch ran faster. They could see a portal on the other side of a river of lava! e

sentences.text_en: Piglins chased them.
sentences.zh: 猪灵们追了上来。

sentences.text_en: It was very difficult to run.
sentences.zh: 跑起来非常困难。

sentences.text_en: "This is not ordinary sand," said Emmy.
sentences.zh: “这不是普通的沙子，”Emmy 说。

sentences.text_en: "It is soul sand!" Skeletons also started firing arrows at them!
sentences.zh: “这是灵魂沙！”骷髅也开始向他们射箭！

sentences.text_en: Emmy and Birch ran faster.
sentences.zh: Emmy 和 Birch 跑得更快了。

sentences.text_en: They could see a portal on the other side of a river of lava!
sentences.zh: 他们看见岩浆河的另一边有一座传送门！

pages.text_en:
"We're trapped," said Birch. Emmy pointed at two striders with red skin and stringy hair. "We can't cross the lava," said Emmy, "but striders can!"
Emmy saddled the striders. She and Birch climbed onto the passive mobs, but the striders stood there, chirping.

sentences.text_en: "We're trapped," said Birch.
sentences.zh: “我们被困住了，”Birch 说。

sentences.text_en: Emmy pointed at two striders with red skin and stringy hair.
sentences.zh: Emmy 指着两只红皮肤、长着细长头发的炽足兽。

sentences.text_en: "We can't cross the lava," said Emmy, "but striders can!" Emmy saddled the striders.
sentences.zh: “我们过不了岩浆，”Emmy 说，“但炽足兽可以！”Emmy 给炽足兽装上了鞍。

sentences.text_en: She and Birch climbed onto the passive mobs, but the striders stood there, chirping.
sentences.zh: 她和 Birch 爬上这些被动型生物，可炽足兽只是站在那里啾啾叫。

pages.text_en:
Emmy offered them carrots. They just kept chirping. Birch had an idea. Carrots did not grow in the Nether. Maybe striders did not eat them.
"Quick! Offer them the blue-green fungi,' Birch shouted as a floating ghast joined the skeletons and piglins. JOTHE

sentences.text_en: Emmy offered them carrots.
sentences.zh: Emmy 给它们胡萝卜。

sentences.text_en: They just kept chirping.
sentences.zh: 它们只是继续啾啾叫。

sentences.text_en: Birch had an idea.
sentences.zh: Birch 想到了一个办法。

sentences.text_en: Carrots did not grow in the Nether.
sentences.zh: 下界里不会生长胡萝卜。

sentences.text_en: Maybe striders did not eat them.
sentences.zh: 也许炽足兽根本不吃胡萝卜。

sentences.text_en: "Quick! Offer them the blue-green fungi,' Birch shouted as a floating ghast joined the skeletons and piglins.
sentences.zh: “快！把蓝绿色真菌给它们！”Birch 喊道。这时，一只漂浮的恶魂加入了骷髅和猪灵的队伍。

pages.text_en:
When the striders saw the fungi, they started running! Emmy and Birch raced toward the portal. RA
On the other side of the portal, they could see Byte. He was waiting for them. He had his stick in his mouth. They were going to make it!

sentences.text_en: When the striders saw the fungi, they started running!
sentences.zh: 炽足兽看见真菌后，开始奔跑！

sentences.text_en: Emmy and Birch raced toward the portal.
sentences.zh: Emmy 和 Birch 朝传送门冲去。

sentences.text_en: On the other side of the portal, they could see Byte.
sentences.zh: 在传送门的另一边，他们看见了 Byte。

sentences.text_en: He was waiting for them.
sentences.zh: 它正在等他们。

sentences.text_en: He had his stick in his mouth.
sentences.zh: 它嘴里叼着那根木棍。

sentences.text_en: They were going to make it!
sentences.zh: 他们就要成功了！

pages.text_en: Safe in the Overworld, Emmy threw the stick. Byte fetched it, and then Birch threw it. Playing with Byte was a great end to a great adventure!

sentences.text_en: Safe in the Overworld, Emmy threw the stick.
sentences.zh: 回到安全的主世界后，Emmy 把木棍扔了出去。

sentences.text_en: Byte fetched it, and then Birch threw it.
sentences.zh: Byte 把木棍捡回来，然后 Birch 又把它扔了出去。

sentences.text_en: Playing with Byte was a great end to a great adventure!
sentences.zh: 和 Byte 玩耍，为这场精彩的冒险画上了完美句号！
